verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe a publishing flow (URL method or MCPB bundle, static server-card metadata) that gives each server a dedicated discoverable page with distribution/install support across clients, plus CLI search/add commands corroborating discovery. However, independent security research found real published servers on the registry contain tool-description injection and a path-traversal vulnerability, indicating publishing/hosting has notable trust and safety gaps not addressed in vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent verification of the publishing UX itself (beyond docs) and evidence Smithery has resolved the flagged security issues.
